title: Disable FileVault disk encryption
summary: Turn off FileVault to decrypt your Mac's startup disk. This removes the encryption protection. The process may take some time to complete.

steps.explain: Disable FileVault encryption. You will be asked for your password.
steps.expect: The command will confirm that FileVault is being disabled.

warnings: Disabling FileVault removes security protection. Ensure you have a valid reason to do this.
The decryption process can take a long time. Do not interrupt it.

rollback.explain: Re-enable FileVault to encrypt the disk again.
